profile.headline: Frontend Developer
profile.summary:
As a senior front-end developer at Tata Consultancy Services, I lead and mentor developers in creating responsive, visually appealing web applications. I have been working in this role for over two years, after gaining valuable experience as a mid-level and junior front-end developer at T-mobile and Walmart Inc. My core competencies include GraphQL, software design, and HTTP.

In my current role, I architect scalable front-end solutions with high code quality and consistency, using GraphQL as a powerful tool for data fetching and manipulation. I also enforce coding standards, conduct code reviews, and promote emerging technologies, such as web accessibility and performance optimization. I collaborate with designers, testers, and other developers to translate complex designs into pixel-perfect interfaces, streamline build and deployment processes, and solve creative problems. I am passionate about learning new skills, sharing best practices, and delivering user-centric solutions that align with the organization's goals and culture. I bring diverse perspectives and experiences to the team, thanks to my background in different industries and domains.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Lead and mentor onshore and offshore front-end developers, fostering innovation and encouraging best practices in Angular and React development. 
Designed and developed user-friendly UI components using Material-UI in React applications for enhanced styling and responsiveness.
Implemented Material-UI themes and custom styling to maintain design consistency across applications.
Used Material-UI Grid System and Flexbox for responsive layouts, improving UI adaptability across devices.
Integrated Material-UI components such as Dialogs, Modals, Tables, Date Pickers, and AutoComplete for a seamless user experience.
Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to create user-friendly web applications using Angular and React.
Maintain front-end architecture and design patterns for consistency and scalability.
Created web pages using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, XML, JSON, JSPs, jQuery, Handlebars, Lodash, SASS, React, and Angular for developing user interfaces.
Added new features using Angular/Redux (RxJS), React/Redux, React Context API, and Lodash to enhance functionality for various modules.
Enforce coding standards, conduct code reviews, and stay up to date with emerging technologies.
Optimize code for performance, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design using React's lazy loading and Suspense features.
Ensure web accessibility by adhering to WCAG standards and implementing comprehensive testing strategies, including compliance with ADA guidelines.
Utilize ARIA roles, attributes, and semantic HTML for enhancing application accessibility and supporting assistive technologies.
Analyze and manipulate the Document Object Model (DOM) layout and JavaScript functions, ensuring cross-browser compatibility using developer tools like Chrome Developer Tools and React Developer Tools.
Developed applications using Angular 16, Angular 18, and React 18, employing Nx Workspace for Mono Repo and Micro Frontend Architecture.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with designers and back-end developers to build user-friendly web applications.
Maintained front-end architecture and design patterns for scalability and consistency.
Developed web pages using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, XML, JSON, JSPs, jQuery, Handlebars, Lodash, SASS, and Angular.
Added new features using Angular, Redux (RxJS), and Lodash to enhance functionality.

Optimized code for performance, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design.

Managed build and deployment processes using Git for efficient code versioning.
Understood client requirements and application flow to ensure seamless development.
Developed an Angular 13 application from scratch using Nx Workspace for a mono-repo structure.
Built Angular applications following a Micro-Frontend Architecture.
Implemented HTTP interceptors for global HTTP calls and error handling.
Designed and built UI screens with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and Angular 13.
Created customized Angular 13 and Angular 15 services to interact with backend APIs.
Extensively utilized @NgModule for module imports, component declarations, and service integration.
Built reusable libraries with Nx and integrated them across multiple applications.
Developed a payment gateway integration and contributed to Java microservices development, including mock APIs.
Worked with Swagger UI for REST service documentation.
Leveraged Angular CLI for front-end development and command-based automation.
Designed dynamic client-side JavaScript code for web forms, navigation, and validation.
Worked in a CI/CD development environment to streamline deployment processes.
Developed responsive web designs using Bootstrap.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Managed, maintained, developed and deployed applications and databases in response to business needs.Developed the front end using HTML, CSS and AngularJS. JavaScript was used for client side validation.Developed cross-browser/platform HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript to match design specs for complex page layouts while adhering to code standards Implemented observables to get a pattern of dealing with data by using array-like operations to parse, modify and maintain data in Angular 13.Developed POC on Angular 13 components and templates for the application, replaced JSON and used Typescript. 
Involved in developing UI pages using Angular 13 and calling the Rest API's from Backend. ∙ Used Angular and Node.JS framework for building web-apps using Restful services. ∙ Involved in developing XML, HTML, and JavaScript for client side presentation and data validation on the client side within the forms. 
Angular 13 Directives, Filters, 2-way Data Binding, Services, Templates, Routing and MVC Dependency Injection to build Single-Page-Applications in a clean and maintainable way. ∙ Developed dashboard front end to support multiple dashboards and their CRUD operations using Typescript. 
Used Bootstrap and Angular UI Bootstrap for creating rich, Responsive UI Screens for varying screen sizes and devices.  
Implemented latest HTML5 and CSS3 features like creating various effects, shading, Shapes, Handling multimedia files and many others. 
Creating cross-browser compatible and standards-compliant CSS based page layouts. Used AJAX to implement front end/user interface features in the application. Utilized various JQUERY plug-in to build Rich Internet Application (RIA) to make it look more intuitive. ∙ 
Involved in team meetings with corporate webmaster’s UI team and end user client for understanding needs in new implementation & involved in daily team meetings & weekly scrum meetings.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with developers to create responsive web applications.
Implemented front-end architecture under senior developers' guidance.
Wrote clean, maintainable code, followed coding standards, and sought feedback.
Stayed updated with front-end technologies, integrated new solutions, and translated design mockups.
Contributed to performance optimization, ensured cross-browser compatibility, and supported responsive design.
Promoted web accessibility and assisted in testing initiatives.
Aided in the build and deployment process, used Git for code management, and maintained clear communication.
Developed UI, layout, and front-end programming using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax, JSON, Angular 10, and Bootstrap 5.
Adopted responsive, mobile-first, and adaptive design principles using Angular 10 libraries with TypeScript.
Designed and coded customized Angular 10 services to interact with backend APIs.
Worked with Angular forms, modules, DOM, events, expressions, controllers, filters, and HTTP requests.
Connected Web APIs to Angular using HTTP calls, implementing GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods.
Fetched and parsed JSON data from Web APIs, rendering it with data visualization components.

Created reusable TypeScript components and services to consume REST APIs using Angular 10 component-based architecture.

Built a Single Page Application (SPA) and various components using Angular 10.
Developed front-end prototypes and themes using Bootstrap, Angular 10, and jQuery.
